query: What's the procedure for notifying law enforcement if a person is being coerced into marriage or has already been married off too young?
reference_answer:
Reporting Forced/Child Marriage:
To report a forced or child marriage, call the Tamil Nadu Police helpline: 1091 or 181. You can also contact the Childline (1098) or visit the nearest police station. Provide details about the incident, and the police will take necessary action.
answer: To notify law enforcement about coerced marriages or underage marriages, contact local child protection services or the police directly. Provide details of the coercion or underage marriage. [Document 1]
